text:
DeployBot: [ALERT] Canary deploy 'gen_v2' in eu-west-1 failing health checks. 20% traffic. 5xx rate jumped to 4.8% over the last 2m. Auto-rollback disabled (policy: manual for model-v2).

Eli: paging @chen — this looks like the rollout we started ~5m ago. can you pick up? :eyes:

Oncall Bot: Paging Chen (oncall). Priority: P1 - service-degradation. Escalation: if no ack in 2m, page Ops Lead.

Chen: ack. looking at canary hosts now. pulling logs from host-7 and host-9.

Chen: quick tail from host-7:
```
ERROR 2026-11-03T21:33:10Z request_id=abcd1234 kv-fetch timeout (2000ms)
WARN  2026-11-03T21:33:11Z retrying request
ERROR 2026-11-03T21:33:12Z request_id=abcd5678 model-inference: upstream 504
```

Chen: seeing a bunch of timeouts when reading KV shards in eu-west-1. error budget spike aligns with canary traffic. not obviously model crash.

Maria: curious — feature flagging service shows 'gen_v2_enabled' at 50% for eu-west-1 but routing shows 20% to canary. possible mismatch between flags and router?

Eli: Maria good catch. earlier rollout used both traffic split and feature flag. if the flag is flipped on some hosts but router still routing, we could have partial behavior. any evidence of inconsistent flag state?

Maria: yes, flag-control logs:
```
2026-11-03T21:30:02Z set gen_v2_enabled=true target=hosts:[host-4,host-7,host-9]
2026-11-03T21:32:05Z set gen_v2_enabled=false target=hosts:[host-4]
```
That leaves host-7 and host-9 still returning gen_v2 responses while other hosts are stable.

Harper (CS): CS reports from 21:35 UTC — two enterprise customers in EU region are seeing 500s on "generate" endpoints. one reported 40% of requests failed. raising as potential customer impact.

Ops Lead: summary so far: canary returning intermittent 5xx due to KV timeouts + partial feature-flag inconsistency causing some hosts to run gen_v2 while others fall back. risk: if we continue traffic shift, we may extend customer impact and potentially trigger automated throttles. proposal: immediate mitigation = 1) set gen_v2_enabled=false across eu-west-1 (force global flag), 2) scale routing weight to 0 for canary, 3) hold and verify. rollback command path below.

Eli: agree. manual steps to execute now? I'm at terminal.

Chen: executing step 1 -> forcing flag off via flag service API:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/flags/gen_v2_enabled/force --data '{"value":false, "scope":"eu-west-1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```
Response: 200 OK, applied to 12 hosts.

Chen: step 2 run: routing control API to remove canary weight:
```
# set canary route weight to 0 for eu-west-1
curl -X POST https://routing.redwood.internal/modify -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","route":"/api/generate","weights":{"stable":1.0,"canary":0.0}}'
```
Response: 202 Accepted. changes propagating (approx 5-10s).

DeployBot: [NOTICE] routing change accepted. Canary weight eu-west-1 -> 0.0. All traffic routed to stable.

Chen: verifying with a few synthetic requests against eu-west-1 edge:
```
# quick smoke
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -w "%{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null https://eu-west-1.edge.redwood/api/generate; done
200
200
200
```
Looks clean on smoke.

Harper (CS): passing update to customers: "We identified an infrastructure issue that affected a recent model rollout in EU region. We've routed traffic back to the stable model and are continuing verification. Will follow up with timeline and root cause once confirmed."

Eli: next: we should also disable the canary job to prevent a reapply while we investigate. Chen can you lock the deployment?

Chen: disabled canary rollout in the orchestrator (flag: rollout.locked=true for gen_v2).

Ops Lead: good. we need verification checklist before we call this mitigated:
- 30m of 200/latency stable in eu-west-1 (no >1% 5xx)
- run regression prompt suite against stable + canary artifacts to confirm output parity
- collect KV shard metrics and check for increased latencies or error tail
- ensure the feature-flag service is stable and reconcile any host-level drift

Maria: starting regression eval now against stable (short smoke subset), will post results in 10m.

Chen: taking ownership of infra RCA for KV timeouts. early hypothesis: shard leader election thrash due to ephemeral network blips during rollout. I'll keep Ops Lead looped.

Eli: Ops Lead, do we want to open a SEV-2 or keep P1? Customer impact is limited to two customers but no large-scale outage.

Ops Lead: marking incident P1-PartialImpact. open SEV-2 to track cross-team RCA and CS comms. assign owners: Chen infra RCA, Maria model/regression, Eli rollout process. Harper will continue customer comms.

Harper (CS): noted. I'll file the customer incident tickets and include the mitigation summary + timeframe.

Maria: regression smoke results: 50 prompts against stable returned expected responses. no regression detected in this quick run. posting log snippet: all pass.

Chen: infra metrics — KV latency peaked at 1200ms for some shards at 21:32, now back to baseline ~45ms. error rate dropped in step with routing change.

Eli: re-enable automated rollback? we should keep auto-rollback disabled until we patch the flag-service inconsistency. Otherwise we'll risk churn.

Ops Lead: agreed. keep auto-rollback disabled, mark rollout flows to require manual approval for gen_v2 until RCA complete.

Chen: handing off to Maria for overnight watch. I'll prepare notes for morning: suspected leader-election bug in kv-proxy, affected subset of nodes when flags changed mid-rollout.

Maria: ack handoff. I'll keep monitoring for 3 hours. if anything spikes I'll page the oncall.

Harper (CS): customers notified with ETA for follow-up. closing customer-facing update for now.

Eli: postmortem owners assigned. Ops Lead will coordinate timeline and docs. tagging for follow-up: #postmortems, #release-safety.

Ops Lead: leaving final note: temporary mitigation = forced flag off + route revert + disabled canary. next actions = infra RCA, fix flag reconciliation bug, update rollout checklist to prevent mixed-flag/traffic rollouts. handoff complete at 21:50 UTC.

Chen: 21:50 UTC — handing to Maria (night) for watch. if anything changes ping Ops Lead immediately.

Maria: 21:56 UTC — monitoring dashboards show 0.2% 5xx in last 5m, latency stable. will update after 30m verification. :white_check_mark:
